name: AH Bot Plus
description: Drop-rate-aware, enhanced Auction House Bot (default 150 items per cycle).

keys.note: PLURAL key, unquoted integer; Plus has no Account/GUID keys
keys.label: Bot character GUIDs
keys.explain: These are the character GUIDS (from characters->characters table) that will be used to create auctions and otherwise interact with auctions. It can be a single value or multiple values that are separated by a comma (do not have spaces!). Note: a GUID of "0" will be ignored! Important: Do not use a bot character (such as playerbot bots) or it will likely crash the server.

keys.label: Sell items
keys.explain: Enable/Disable the part of AHBot that puts items up for auction.

keys.label: Items posted per cycle
keys.explain: How many items to post on the auction house every house update. Items in a cycle will be posted by a randomly selected bot.

keys.label: Minutes between sell cycles
keys.explain: How many minutes to wait before selling items again. Value can be a single number in order to wait X minutes before selling again, or a pair of numbers separated by a ':' to wait a random number of minutes between X and Y (e.g. 3:15 to wait 3-15 minutes between cycles).

keys.label: Use drop rates when listing
keys.explain: Enable/Disable the Seller using items' in-game drop rates from Enemies and GameObjects to determine the probability of listing them on the AH. This makes rare items appear less frequently on the AH.

prompts.question: GUID of the AH bot character (create the AHBOT account + ONE character first, log it out)

exists.query: SELECT name FROM characters WHERE guid = {bot_guid}
exists.missing: no character in this server's own database has GUID {bot_guid} — create the AHBOT account and ONE character, log that character out, then try again

notes: Same active conf filename as mod-ah-bot (mod_ahbot.conf); both modules define the same C++ classes, so installing one refuses while the other is present. wow-manage.sh 5969-5982, 2335-2340.
